description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - Industrial Disputes between, M. A. Ranasinghe Vs. Sri Lanka Airlines Limited and two other notices

It involves statutory instruments (orders under Section 4(1) of the Act), legal procedures for dispute resolution, and regulatory actions by the Minister. While it mentions Minister Ravindra Samaraweera, this is in his capacity as the authority making legal/regulatory orders under specific legislation, not as a personnel appointment or government structural change.
